findings.passage: Our Democratic Republic cannot survive without free, fair, and legal elections. Elections should be controlled and transparent at the State level. The public trust in elections can only be maintained if a common sense process is used to register, verify legal identity and residency, and count the votes within each precinct. The entire process has to have immediate transparency for public scrutiny.
findings.note: Election Integrity plank on his campaign site. Names verifying legal identity and residency as part of registration; does not name photo ID, citizenship documents or mail ballots. Site page is undated.
